about: The ONE constants file (Blueprint invariant 14; A26's shared shape, R32). Each set is closed: every value carries its own code, or is fixed by an outside standard, and each names its authority and why it is closed (FEATURE_PIPELINE section 5 item 14). A subset names its parent set, and every value of a subset is a value of its parent. The API reads this file through functions/src/config/closedSets.js; the app reads app/lib/core/config/closed_sets.dart, generated from it by `npm run gen:closed-sets` (a tools test fails while that file is stale). Wording for each value lives in ARB, keyed by value; the values themselves are codes, never shown.

ConnectorCostModel.authority: db/schema.sql 0.14 CK_ConnectorType_CostModel; Blueprint section 3.2. The publish engine reads it for the lift and two-ended connector rules (spec/P0-03.md r2 AC-15, AC-33; ruled D7). The venue map document's validator checks that a connector's ConnectorType code has the CostModel of its kind (spec/OA-1.md r1 section 2.6, AC-7).
ConnectorCostModel.whyClosed: Each value is a connector behaviour in code (how its ends and rise are read, step-free, evacuation); connector TYPES are the ConnectorType lookup.

NavCorrectionKind.authority: db/schema.sql 0.14 CK_NavCorrection_Kind; L32; spec/P0-03.md r2 DC-6 and AC-27; spec/OA-1.md r1 section 2.5.5 (a correction's kind in the venue map document) and AC-21.
NavCorrectionKind.whyClosed: Each kind is a graph-generation operation in code.

ImdfUnitCategory.authority: IMDF 1.0.0, OGC 20-094 Categories, fetched 2026-10-12 (docs.ogc.org/cs/20-094/Categories/index.html, the Unit table: 63 values, as published); invariant 14 (fixed by an outside standard); spec/OA-1.md r1 section 2.5.3 and AC-21.
ImdfUnitCategory.whyClosed: Fixed by an outside standard: the IMDF 1.0.0 unit categories, as published. Gabay neither adds nor renames one.

WallKind.authority: OFFICE_MAP_DESIGNER_SPEC.md section 4.2 (Wall: kind solid, glass or partition); spec/OA-1.md r1 section 2.5.1 and AC-21.
WallKind.whyClosed: Each kind is drawn and modelled in code (the renderer, the publish engine's walls, the beacon planner's signal model); a new kind needs new code.

OpeningKind.authority: OFFICE_MAP_DESIGNER_SPEC.md section 4.2 (Opening: kind door or window); spec/OA-1.md r1 section 2.5.2, AC-8 and AC-21.
OpeningKind.whyClosed: Each kind is a rule in code: a door is walked through and may be an entrance or a unit's door; a window is never walked through.

ConnectorKind.authority: OFFICE_MAP_DESIGNER_SPEC.md section 4.2 (Connector: stairs, escalator, elevator), plus ramp (plan/OFFICE-ADOPTION-replan.md 1.0 section 1.2; P0-07); spec/OA-1.md r1 section 2.6, AC-7 and AC-21.
ConnectorKind.whyClosed: Each kind carries its own geometry rules in code (levels, size ranges, shape, two-way) and matches one ConnectorCostModel; connector TYPES are the ConnectorType lookup.

ConnectorShape.authority: OFFICE_MAP_DESIGNER_SPEC.md section 4.2 (stairs: shape straight, L or U); spec/OA-1.md r1 section 2.6 (stairs and ramps) and AC-21.
ConnectorShape.whyClosed: Each shape is geometry code in the renderer and in the landing rules.

ItemFinish.authority: OFFICE_MAP_DESIGNER_SPEC.md section 5 (item finishes: keys only; the renderer owns the colours); spec/OA-1.md r1 section 2.5.4, AC-21 and AC-22; rule 6.
ItemFinish.whyClosed: Each key has its own light and dark colour token in app/lib/core/theme/gabay_tokens.dart (rule 6); the document stores the key, never a colour.

FloorFinish.authority: OFFICE_MAP_DESIGNER_SPEC.md section 5 (floor finishes: keys only); spec/OA-1.md r1 sections 2.4 and 2.5.3, AC-21 and AC-22; rule 6.
FloorFinish.whyClosed: Each key has its own light and dark colour token in app/lib/core/theme/gabay_tokens.dart (rule 6); the document stores the key, never a colour.

ItemMount.authority: OFFICE_MAP_DESIGNER_SPEC.md section 5 (mount: floor or wall); spec/OA-1.md r1 AC-21 and AC-44 (the catalog's mount).
ItemMount.whyClosed: Each mount is placement code in the editor (a wall item snaps flat onto a wall face) and in the renderer.

PublishBlockingKind.authority: spec/P0-03.md r4 section 3.14.8 and AC-107 to AC-109 (L170 Q2: publish blocks only on these); EC-36; plan/FF-3-prime-A1.md 1.0 step 11. A1's PublishProblemKind, renamed; a kind that survives keeps A1's spelling (DC-25). INVALID_DOCUMENT, NOTHING_TO_PUBLISH (ruled 2026-10-14, Q3 (a)) and TENANT_MISMATCH AC-108; BEACON_DUPLICATE, BEACON_NAMESPACE, BEACON_MIXED_MAJOR and BEACON_MAJOR_SHARED (ruled 2026-10-14, Q2 (a)) AC-109. The order is AC-115's sort order: blocking first, then each kind's place here.
PublishBlockingKind.whyClosed: Each kind is a check the publish engine runs in code and refuses a publish on; a new kind needs new code and its ARB wording (AC-128).

PublishWarningKind.authority: spec/P0-03.md r4 section 3.14.8 and AC-107 (the warning kinds are exactly these); EC-36; plan/FF-3-prime-A1.md 1.0 step 11. NO_BEACONS_ON_LEVEL AC-22; DOOR_WIDTH_UNMEASURED AC-23; GRAPH_LARGE and PACKAGE_LARGE AC-75; UNREVIEWED AC-113; UNREACHABLE AC-110; ORPHAN AC-111; WALL_CROSSING AC-97; NO_ENTRANCE AC-98; CONNECTOR_OFF_WALKWAY, CONNECTOR_NO_RISE, OUTSIDE_BOUNDARY and SHAPE_SELF_CROSSING AC-112; STORE_WITHOUT_UNIT, STORE_DUPLICATE_UNIT and BEACON_LEVEL_MISSING AC-114. Spellings kept from A1 (DC-25); the order is AC-115's sort order after the blocking kinds.
PublishWarningKind.whyClosed: Each kind is a check the publish engine or the publish service runs in code; a warning never refuses a publish (L170 Q2), and a new kind needs new code and its ARB wording (AC-128).

GraphEdgeKind.authority: spec/P0-03.md r4 AC-105 and AC-132 (walk, connector or store crossing); spec/P0-06.md r5 section 3 item 1; plan/FF-3-prime-A1.md 1.0 section 2 (the package model's edge kind is an index into this list, in this order).
GraphEdgeKind.whyClosed: Each kind is a way the router treats an edge in code: a walkway, a ride on a connector, or a crossing through a walk-through store (L92).

EvacuationAmenityType.authority: L87; spec/P0-03.md r3 AC-88 (Q20, ruled 2026-10-12, residual sheet R29), kept in r4 by AC-110; db/seeds/lib/lookups.js (the platform AmenityType rows REFUGE_AREA and ASSEMBLY_AREA). The publish engine leaves these amenities out of reachability until P3-02.
EvacuationAmenityType.whyClosed: Each code is an evacuation behaviour in code (left out of reachability and of search until P3-02, AC-88); every other amenity type is the AmenityType lookup, and a tenant's own type with another code is an ordinary amenity (EC-67).

WalkableUnitCategory.authority: spec/P0-11.md r2 DC-8 (the seeds use walkway, parking and footbridge as walkable); spec/OA-1.md r1 AC-9 and AC-21.
WalkableUnitCategory.whyClosed: A unit's walkable flag defaults from its category in code (the validator fills it when absent, AC-9); the admin sets walkable on a unit to override it.
